title: One-Room Scheduling
statement:
Use earliest-finish greedy to choose the maximum number of nonoverlapping screenings. Screenings occupy half-open intervals, so touching is allowed.

Input
n and n lines of start end.

Output
Print the maximum number that fit in one room.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each integer interval obeys −10⁹ ≤ start < end ≤ 10⁹.
